image_description: A close-up, slightly low-angle shot of a white and blue steam iron resting on a dark surface. The iron features a glossy white plastic body with blue accents, a metallic soleplate visible at the bottom, and a brownish/gold handle area. A power cord is partially visible extending from the rear. The background is a blurred dark blue/grey wall.

Critical functional details (steam holes) are missing. The surface is unnaturally smooth and uniform, failing to replicate the complex perforation pattern of a real iron.
The transition between the gold/brown handle area and the white body is slightly blurry and ill-defined, suggesting minor geometric fusion.
